observation.method: Playwright Chromium read-only navigation; manual review of rendered control text, link destinations, safe attributes and ancestor/landmark context; screenshots additionally reviewed for gov-search, agency-faq and library-program.

Minimal fixture styling does not reproduce original geometry, overlays, scrolling, images, scripts or event handlers.
Script-backed links/buttons are locate only; the fixture does not simulate their application behavior.

task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: FAQ 원본 링크는 javascript:goMenuPage(...)이므로 목적지 주소를 추정 이동시키지 않고 원본 위치로 안내.
